title: Wearable Technology in Shoulder Range of Motion
brief_summary: The scope of the research is to determine if a motion-based software development kit may substitute for a manual goniometer. If so, this opens up the possibility of remote telemonitoring of upper extremities patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No prior shoulder pain
* No prior shoulder surgeries
* No limitations in shoulder range of motion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior shoulder surgeries
* Past or present shoulder pain
* Any limitations in shoulder range of motion
study_population: Healthy individuals between 18 and 40 years of age with no prior shoulder pain, no prior shoulder surgeries, and no limitations in shoulder range of motion will be included.
